description.value:
A point you choose within range becomes the center of a 60-foot-radius sphere of bright light, with dim light extending 60 feet beyond that. Choosing an object you hold or one that is unattended causes the light to move with it; wrapping the object in something opaque blocks the glow entirely.

Any area of enhanced darkness created by a power of 3rd level or lower that overlaps this light is dispelled.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
